text:
sasha: Need a tight benchmark narrative for next week: headline + 3 charts + short social. Focus: latency SLOs + unit cost.

anya: Suggest headline: "Lower inference cost, same latency guarantees." Add a lab stat in the blog to back it.

miguel: Keep multipliers conservative. Proposed lab callout: "Up to ~1.4x infra savings at matched P95 for common chat loads (256 tokens)" with a footnote.

jamal: I'll run a reproducible sweep: models=redwood-4b-fp16, redwood-4b-q5, redwood-4b-q8; seq=64,256,512; batch=1,8,32. Metrics: p50, p95, tokens/sec. Cost = GPU-min + infra overhead / tokens.

benchbot: Sweep queued by jamal. Tracker: https://redwood.share/bench/launch-apr24 (view).

jamal: Sweep done. Quick summary: redwood-4b-q5 shows ~1.4x lower infra cost at matched P95 vs fp16 for seq=256 batch=8. Gap reduces for longer sequences. Lab GPU price used = $3.10/hr, infra overhead = 10%. Full CSV in tracker.

anya: Chart set: 1) P95 latency vs throughput (lines per variant), 2) cost per 100k tokens (hosted vs dedicated vs baseline), 3) tail-latency heatmap. Social tile: compact cost badge + one-liner.

miguel: Add methodology slide listing command and pricing assumptions. Keep competitor row anonymous (e.g., "Other API").

olivia: GTM asks: landing one-liner + 3 bullets, webinar CTA capturing avg tokens/min, and UTM params utm_campaign=bench_launch_apr2024&utm_medium=social. SDR routing: tag leads "bench_estimate"; enterprise threshold: avg tokens/min > 5000 or monthly > 10M.

sasha: Draft landing blurb: "Redwood Inference: predictable latency SLOs and lower per-token cost across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." CTA: "Get estimate"

jamal: Repro command to include in methodology slide:
```bash
python tools/bench_sweep.py --models redwood-4b-fp16,redwood-4b-q5,redwood-4b-q8 --seq 64,256,512 --batch 1,8,32 --metrics p50,p95,tokens_per_sec --out results/launch_sweep.csv
```

anya: Social copy (X): "New benchmark: lower inference costs without sacrificing latency SLOs. See lab data + request a personalized estimate. [link] #inference #llm" (under 220 chars).

benchbot: Slide export uploaded: https://redwood.share/slides/bench-launch-v2. Feedback enabled.

olivia: I'll set up landing with the UTM and the short form for tokens/min. Routing rules configured today.

miguel: I'll review blog draft for technical accuracy and provide an engineer quote on batching and KV caching.

sasha: Next steps: jamal finalize CSV + methodology (today), design produce 3 chart variants (EOD tomorrow), olivia+anya draft blog/landing (tomorrow AM), internal review 1600PT tomorrow. Flag risky claims here. :rocket:
